In a pan over low heat, add the mozzarella cheese slices and baby Swiss. Let them start to melt. Add ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, and green onions. Mix everything well. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until fully coated in the sauce. Top with shredded mozzarella cheese, then cover and let it melt. Finish with crispy bacon, a fried egg, sausage, dumplings, or any toppings you like. Drizzle with more chili oil and top with green onions.
